We need to determine appropriate crimes based on Chinese criminal law.

Facts: Liu2 bought disabled persons' personal info (25,751 records) and phone, bank cards etc. Then used info to call people, pretended to be civil affairs bureau staff, defrauded victims of 302,840 yuan transferred to accounts. So crimes: (1) Fraud (诈骗罪) – using false pretenses to obtain property. (2) Illegal acquisition of personal information – illegal provision of personal information? Under Chinese law, there is crime of "非法获取公民个人信息罪" (illegal acquisition of personal information) and "非法提供公民个人信息罪". The fact: He purchased personal info, then used it. So illegal acquisition of personal information (非法获取公民个人信息罪) and possibly illegal provision? He used it to defraud, not necessarily providing to others. So charge: "非法获取公民个人信息罪". Also possibly "诈骗罪". Also maybe "侵犯公民个人信息罪" but the official term is "非法获取公民个人信息罪". Also "诈骗罪" is correct.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗罪;非法获取公民个人信息罪<eoa>
